source: U.S. Census Bureau, data.census.gov table ACSDT5Y2023.B01003 (ACS 5-year 2019-2023, Total Population)
preprocessing: Counties of AL, FL, GA, NC, SC, TN; 60 most populous kept as customer zones; demand = population x 1.5 pallets / 1,000 residents / week

source: U.S. Census Bureau, data.census.gov table CBP2022.CB2200CBP (County Business Patterns 2022), NAICS 493 Warehousing and Storage
preprocessing: All-employment-size/all-legal-form row; missing source rows remain unknown; 22 candidate DC counties, tier = large if EMP >= 3,000 (assumed rule) -> assumed capacity 12,000/7,000 pallets/week

source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Centers of Population by County
preprocessing: Population mean centers used as county proxies; not warehouse addresses or port coordinates
density = population / land area; assumed rule scales DC fixed cost from -15% to +15%

source: Bureau of Transportation Statistics / ATRI county-to-county truck travel times 2024 (data.bts.gov uta5-4eu5)
preprocessing: 1,320 county pairs; 1,300 BTS rows; 20 local pairs assumed 30 min; 0 nonlocal pairs imputed; 180 BTS rows adjusted using an assumed 55-mph centroid floor; modeled p50 threshold 480 min; no delivery guarantee

source: Great-circle distance x circuity; ATRI 2024 operational cost
preprocessing: estimated road miles = 1.2 x haversine (assumed); historical $2.27/truck-mile operating-cost benchmark, not a freight quote; outbound $0.1247 and inbound $0.1004 per pallet-mile
